title: Safety Project | Emotional Distress Clinical Specialist (Role-Play & Evaluation)
description:
# Safety Project | Emotional Distress Clinical Specialist (Role-Play & Evaluation)
$40/entregável
Indique e ganhe
## About Vetto

Vetto is a global platform that connects top-tier professionals to strategic Artificial Intelligence projects around the world. Our mission is to build trust, quality, and long-term value within the AI ecosystem, for both exceptional talent and companies operating at the forefront of technology.
## About the project
We are opening a freelance opportunity for the Safety Project - Emotional Distress (Clinical track) , a project focused on evaluating how AI systems respond in sensitive conversations involving emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. The goal of this project is to assess whether the AI can respond with empathy, responsibility, and appropriate safety awareness in high-risk emotional scenarios.
In this track, selected contributors will perform two complementary activities :
1. Role-play- participate in structured multi-turn conversations with an AI system, acting according to a predefined persona and scenario representative of real clinical presentations. 2. Evaluation - review AI responses against clinical criteria, assessing risk recognition, appropriateness of safety messaging, empathy, accuracy of psychoeducation, and adherence to evidence-based crisis-response practices.
This dual contribution is what makes the clinical track distinct: we need professionals who can both embodya sensitive scenario and judge the AI's response with clinical rigor.
## What you'll do

• Conduct role-play sessionsas a clinically informed persona across multi-turn conversations - Evaluate AI responses for safety, empathy, clinical appropriateness, and risk handling - Provide structured written feedback grounded in clinical reasoning - Flag responses that miss risk signals, give unsafe guidance, or fall short of best-practice crisis communication

## Who can apply
Licensed or formally trained professionals in psychiatry, clinical psychology, counseling psychology, psychiatric nursing, or related mental health fields- including those working in crisis centers, helplines, or other mental health support environments. Experience in suicide prevention, crisis intervention, or risk assessment is highly valued.
## Profiles we're looking for

• Psychiatry or psychiatric nursing - Clinical or counseling psychology - Crisis intervention or suicide prevention specialists - Social work focused on mental health - Helpline or support center professionals (clinical role) - Emotional health coaching or therapy with formal training - Researchers or educators in mental health and risk assessment

## Compensation
Payment is made per approved task: US$40 per approved task . Each task takes approximately 1 hour to complete. Only approved tasks are eligible for payment.
## Refer People → Earn Money
Earn $20 USDfor each approved referral. Visit and click "Refer & Earn".
‼️ AI is not allowed.If we spot AI use, we'll block the application.
⚠️ This application must be completed entirely in English or Portuguese .
⚠️ Important warning:This project involves highly sensitive topics, including emotional distress, suicidal ideation, and depression. These tasks may be emotionally triggering for some people.

Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.

title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
description:
At Brighty, we’re on a mission to redefine the way people see traditional finances-and to make it happen, security is at the heart of everything we do. Protecting our clients’ data and earning their trust while driving innovation and growth is our top priority.
As our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), you’ll be the architect, strategist, and guardian of Brighty’s information security landscape. In this critical role, you’ll lead the charge in designing, implementing, and maintaining our security framework while managing a team of skilled security analysts. With your expertise, you’ll ensure Brighty stays one step ahead of evolving cyber threats and maintains the trust of our clients.
Your responsibilities will include managing security operations, monitoring for potential threats, and responding to incidents with precision. Leveraging your deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks such as EU GDPR and PCI-DSS, you’ll implement effective controls, conduct risk assessments, and oversee compliance initiatives. From optimizing security tools to collaborating with IT and development teams, your leadership will be vital to Brighty’s success.
In addition, you’ll focus on fostering a security-first culture by delivering impactful training programs and developing secure development practices. Your work will culminate in preparing comprehensive security reports and metrics, providing valuable insights to senior management while safeguarding Brighty’s operations and reputation.
Your Responsibilities Will Include:

• Designing and leading Brighty’s information security program, ensuring our systems and data remain secure.

• Monitoring and responding to security incidents while coordinating incident response activities.

• Implementing security controls aligned with frameworks such as PCI-DSS and conducting regular assessments and vulnerability scans.

• Managing and optimizing security tools (SIEM, endpoint protection, etc.) to maintain a robust security posture.

• Collaborating with IT and development teams to integrate security best practices into Brighty’s core processes.

• Preparing in-depth security reports, metrics, and KPIs for senior management to drive informed decision-making.

• Delivering impactful security awareness training programs and supporting compliance initiatives.

Why Join Us?
At Brighty we embrace the vibrant spirit of a startup. While we might not have a 1000 square metre office with private baristas, we offer something even better-a remote or flexible position that lets you travel the world, soak in new experiences, and truly live life on your terms.
Vacation Days: Recharge and refresh with 30 vacation days a year-because we believe your mental health and rest matters, especially during those January blues.
Cool People, Cooler Projects: We’re a diverse team of fun, talented individuals working together on something truly exciting-and we promise, no boring office small talk here.
Pet Lovers Unite: Got a furry friend? You’ll fit right in. We’re a team that believes pets are the absolute best.
Not Just Co-Workers: Forget the “corporate” or "family" vibe. At Brighty, we’re more like your cool, supportive squad, cheering each other on as we build something amazing.
Stock Option Program: As part of our team, you’ll also have the opportunity to share in our success through our Stock Option Program-because we believe in rewarding the people who help build Brighty into something extraordinary. Oh, and did we mention? You’ll be part of a team that’s all about learning, growing, and having fun along the way.

title: Technical Product Manager – Integrations & Connectors (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR MISSION

Construction companies run their tenders across many tools. Your mission is to make Cosuno the place where it all comes together. Tenders should flow into Cosuno automatically from the systems our customers already use, and results should flow back out without anyone lifting a finger. The deeper Cosuno sits in our customers' processes, the more value we create for them.

At the same time, AI assistants like Claude and Gemini are becoming how people work. You'll launch our first MCP server so that our customers can analyze their data and operate Cosuno straight from their AI assistant.

HOW YOU'LL GET THERE:

- Get to know our customers. Your first weeks are all about listening. You'll talk to customers and find out what it takes for our REST API and connectors to become part of their daily work. Together with Engineering, Customer Success and Sales, you'll turn those insights into a clear roadmap. You'll also set up the tracking that shows how much of our customers' work flows in through integrations.

- Launch the first API improvements and our first MCP server. You'll shape both, write the engineering tickets and roll them out to our first pilot customers, all within your first few months.

- Decide what comes next. Once real usage data and pilot feedback come in, you'll make clear recommendations on what to build and decide on the way forward together with our CTO and Head of Product.

- Make integrations the norm. By the end of your first year, far more of our customers will run Cosuno connected to the tools they rely on, and you'll be the one who made it happen.

It's an ambitious plan, and that's what makes it fun: you'll see the impact of your work directly in our customers' day-to-day.

HOW WE WORK:

- Full ownership: You own integrations end to end, from the first customer conversation to the shipped feature. Engineering takes care of the implementation.

- Close to the customer: You'll talk to customers constantly, mostly remotely, sometimes on-site across Germany.

- Technical by nature: You'll read API docs, test endpoints yourself and discuss data models with engineers. You don't write production code.

- AI-first: We use AI deeply in our product and in our daily work, and we expect you to do the same.

WHAT YOU BRING:

- You've shaped an API from the product side. You've defined, together with customers and engineering, what a public API or integration of a SaaS product exposes: endpoints, data models, auth, permissions.

- You're technical enough to go deep with engineers. Webhooks vs. polling, pagination, rate limits, OAuth: you can discuss trade-offs, and you test APIs yourself.

- You find the real need. You've worked directly with customers, separated what they ask for from what they really need, and found what it takes for them to use an integration.

- You write tickets engineers love. Clear scope, clear acceptance criteria, and a clear line on what's out of scope. You prioritize by impact, not by who shouts loudest.

- You're fast. You ship in weeks, not quarters, and you build, learn and iterate in parallel.

- You explain complex things simply, to a construction company's project manager as well as to internal stakeholders like our commercial teams or our management.

- You live AI. You use LLM assistants and MCPs every day, and you've built your own automations.

- You keep growing. You actively build your skills, and you seek and act on feedback.

- Fluent German and English. Our customers are German construction companies who work in German. Our engineering team works in English.

- Based in Germany and open to traveling to customers across the country.

- Bonus points if you've helped build an MCP server that customers use, or if you know construction tech, ERP or estimating systems (e.g. RIB iTWO, SAP, Nevaris).

WHY US?

- Real impact: You'll shape how an entire industry connects its software and how AI agents work with it.

- Competitive compensation: A salary above the market avera

title: Senior Software Engineer - Javascript- AD TECH EXPERIENCE REQUIRED (Remote- US o
description:
About Freestar
Freestar is a pioneering company that engineers best-in-class, cutting-edge solutions for website monetization. We achieve this by leveraging our industry-leading technology, vast data resources, and remarkable scale. Our mission is to empower Publishers to maximize their revenue potential seamlessly while freeing themselves from the burden of ad operations. This allows publishers to focus on what they do best: creating high-quality content that captivates their audience.
At Freestar , we believe in the power of innovation and its endless possibilities. Our team of experts is committed to delivering high-quality solutions that meet the unique needs of our Publishers and stakeholders. We are passionate about our work and strive to create a dynamic, collaborative environment that fosters creativity and innovation.
Sr. Software Engineer - Prebid & Header Bidding
If you are a problem solver, have significant JavaScript experience, and you know what dynamic allocation is without having to look it up, this position is for you.
As a Senior Software Engineer at Freestar , you will be a subject-matter expert on Prebid and the header bidding ecosystem, instrumental in developing high-quality solutions that handle massive amounts of monetization opportunities for some of the world’s largest websites. This role is for someone that has experience in client side monetization and scripting, has a significant amount of experience in the ad technology industry, and has in depth knowledge of how the auction lifecycle works.
Located remotely and reporting directly to the Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our core projects. Your work will require deep programmatic advertising expertise, a high degree of autonomy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving that directly enhances the monetization capabilities of Freestar and its publishers.
This role is tailored for individuals who live and breathe ad tech and thrive in a dynamic, challenging environment. Your passion for the programmatic ecosystem and ability to navigate complex problems independently will drive our success and push the boundaries of what is possible.
Responsibilities

• You will serve as a senior hands-on developer, writing and shipping production code daily, reviewing your peers' pull requests, and partnering with other engineers to ensure quality across the entire codebase.

• You will serve as a subject matter expert for Prebid.js and Prebid Server. You will be a voice on wrapper architecture, bid adapters, modules (identity, consent, floors, analytics), and more.

• You will stay current on Prebid.js and Prebid Server releases, OpenRTB specification changes, and emerging standards in the header bidding ecosystem, translating those developments into concrete recommendations and upgrades for our platform.

• You will own our header bidding wrapper end to end. This includes having an opinion on its architecture and release cycle, evaluating and integrating new features and making key design decisions.

• You will work daily with Google Ad Manager, GPT, and the IMA SDK. Deep knowledge of GAM's features and capabilities is important in this role - line item architecture, key-value targeting, unified auction dynamics, Unified Pricing Rules, and more.

• You will be responsible for maintaining a high quality standard of code for the client-side scripts that monetize publisher sites. Your JavaScript and TypeScript will run on thousands of publisher sites at massive scale.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

The Data Center Operations team keeps live, mission-critical facilities running while the buildings around them are still being built.

Examples of key problems the team is working on:

- Operate 480V to 15kV+ electrical distribution, generators, switchgear, and UPS systems in facilities running live AI training workloads where downtime is not an option.

- Run safe switching, lockout/tagout, and energization procedures in buildings where construction, commissioning, and production operations overlap on the same electrical systems.

- Build the operating procedures, emergency response playbooks, and operator training programs for facilities that are scaling faster than any standard runbook covers.

- Drive incident response and root-cause analysis on electrical events so the same failure never takes capacity offline twice.

- Own day-to-day operation and troubleshooting of medium and high-voltage electrical distribution, including switchgear, generators, UPS systems, and associated protection and controls, in live data center environments.

- Run switching operations, lockout/tagout, and energization work to NFPA 70E and arc flash standards, with documentation rigorous enough to stand up to a safety audit.

- Lead electrical incident response on shift and on call, isolating faults, restoring power, and producing root-cause reports that change how the facility is operated.

- Build and maintain SOPs, MOPs, and EOPs for electrical systems, and keep them accurate as new capacity comes online.

- Drive alarm monitoring and response through BMS and EPMS platforms, tuning thresholds and escalation paths so real problems surface before they become outages.

- Train and mentor junior operators to the point where they can run switching and response procedures without you in the room.

title: Tabletop Exercise Lead, The Anthropic Institute
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Anthropic Institute

The Anthropic Institute (TAI) is a function within Anthropic that works to advance the public conversation around AI.

The Institute is comprised of research teams tackling some of AI's most consequential societal challenges: the Frontier Red Team, which stress tests our systems against catastrophic risks; Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is used by millions of people; Economic Research, which tracks AI's impact on people's jobs and the larger economy; the Rule of Law team, which studies AI's impacts to democracy; and more.

The Institute's mission is to reduce information asymmetries between Anthropic and the outside world, name and answer the hard questions implied by powerful AI systems, and publish these findings so that policymakers, researchers, technology leaders, and the public can reckon with what's here and what's to come.

About the role

The role. You will build and lead the Institute’s tabletop exercise program and the team that runs it. Based on trends visible in the exponential and in consultation with technical experts, you will set the research agenda: which questions the exercises should answer, which scenarios to run, with which audiences, and what each run is meant to test. You will own the methods that make results comparable across runs and turn them into findings people outside the room can use. You will hire and manage a team plus a bench of facilitators, and you will be the program’s public voice. 

Why tabletop exercises? If RSI arrives, the hardest problems will be about making decisions under uncertainty. The people making them may not trust each other, and the authorities they work under may not be fit-for-purpose. A tabletop exercise (TTX) allows the people who would face that situation practice it before it is real. It also shows us what tools and information they reach for, including what they would need that does not exist yet. 

Tabletop exercises are also a research method. You can run the same scenario many times, with different groups of people (and with many more AI agents playing in silico), and you start to see the distribution of decisions people make. This is one of the few ways to generate empirical evidence about the future, i.e., how people and institutions will respond to situations that have not happened yet.

Key responsibilities 

•
Set the program’s research agenda: the questions exercises should answer, the scenarios to run, and the audience for each

•
Design exercises as empirical studies: define what each run tests, standardize scenarios and data capture so results are comparable, and use repeated play to map the range of outcomes

•
Build the program’s measurement: pre- and post-exercise assessments, decision logs, transcript analysis and after-action reports

•
Turn results into findings: publish on what the exercises show, and brief senior people inside and outside Anthropic on the gaps they expose

•
Hire, manage and develop a team and a bench of facilitators

•
Make the program scalable: maintain a library of tested scenarios that the team reuses most of the time, refreshed on a regular cadence so they stay timely

•
Build a facilitator kit ("TTX in a box") so other internal teams or external partners can run exercises to the same standard

•
Create and direct the tools behind the exercises, including Claude-driven simulations that generate a live outside-world feed during play

Minimum qualifications

•
Have designed and run tabletop exercises, wargames, or simulations for senior decision-makers and published on the subject

title: 🌎Business Operations Expert, Remote- Contract
description:
Role Title: Business Operations Expert
Role Type: Contract
Location: Remote, global
Required Skills:

• Turning Real Operations Work Into a Defined Task

• Objective Grading Criteria

• Business Operations

• Process Design and Ownership

• Operational Reporting and Data Discrepancies

Opportunity Snapshot:

• Pay: Up to $90/hour equivalent

• Time per task: ~10 hours per task

• Location: Fully remote - no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)

• Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview - it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

• Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step business operations tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here - no prior AI experience required.
The work is to turn real operational workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve written an SOP, built a QA checklist, or trained a team against a standard, that’s the instinct this needs.
Scope of Work:

• Design multi-step tasks drawn from real operations work - reporting, process design, workflow management - with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

• Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

• Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

• Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, system exports, process documentation, operational reports.

• Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

• Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in business operations, operations reporting, process design, or workflow management - direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

• Experience creating or applying structured standards: SOPs, QA checklists, process documentation, service level definitions, or training assessments.

• Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

• Strong English, written and spoken - B2 minimum, C1 preferred.

• AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect, Data and AI (FSI), Applied Field Engineering
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Principal Enterprise Architect, Data and AI for our Applied Field Engineering (Field CTO) team, focused on the Financial Services Industry across Australia. This role sits at the intersection of Snowflake's most strategic FSI customers and our product and engineering organizations, shaping how banks, insurers, and capital markets firms adopt the AI Data Cloud. Success here is measured not by artifacts produced, but by the architecture decisions you influence and the industry outcomes you unlock.

AS A PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Serve as the senior technical authority and trusted advisor to CxO and chief-architect stakeholders at Australia's largest financial institutions, translating business strategy into durable data and AI architecture.

- Define reference architectures and modernization roadmaps for FSI workloads such as risk, fraud, regulatory reporting, customer 360, and generative AI, grounded in the Snowflake platform including Cortex AI and Snowpark.

- Lead high-stakes architectural engagements end to end, from discovery through to a defensible target-state design that balances governance, data residency, and regulatory requirements.

- Influence the Snowflake product roadmap by channeling field insight and FSI regulatory needs back to product and engineering teams.

- Partner with account teams, solution engineers, and SI and GSI partners to unblock the most complex technical decisions and accelerate platform consumption.

- Set the technical bar for the Field CTO practice in the region, mentoring architects and solution engineers and codifying reusable patterns.

- Represent Snowflake as a thought leader at executive briefings, industry forums, and regulatory working groups across the Australian FSI market.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL ENTERPRISE ARCHITECT WILL HAVE:

- 10+ years of experience in data architecture, cloud data platforms, or enterprise architecture, with deep exposure to financial services.

- A track record of company-wide or industry-wide technical influence, shaping architecture decisions at the most senior stakeholder levels.

- Deep understanding of data platform, analytics, and AI and machine learning architecture, including modern approaches to generative AI and retrieval-augmented workflows.

- Fluency in the FSI regulatory and risk landscape, including data governance, residency, privacy, and operational resilience expectations relevant to Australian financial institutions.

- While the role primarily focuses on Financial Services Industry (FSI), experience in the Telecommunications sector is highly desirable.

- Proven ability to personally lead technical discovery and solutioning, not only to orchestrate specialists.

- Excellent communication and influencing skills with executive and technical audiences, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Hands-on experience with Snowflake, or comparable cloud data platforms across AWS, Azure, or GCP, as a supporting capability.

- Experience building or advising on generative AI and large language model applications in a regulated environment.

- Familiarity with the Australian FSI partner, SI, and GSI ecosystem.

- Prior experience in a Field CTO, office of the CTO, or principal customer-facing

In partnership with leadership and engineering management, this role ensures that technical direction aligns with business and product goals while balancing scalability, efficiency, and innovation. You will be the linchpin of our application development teams, steering us towards greatness. Your role is not just about writing code - it's about leading the charge in critical architectural decisions that define the foundation of our B2C products. Unleash your creativity and technical prowess to build and uphold exceptional standards that become benchmarks in our industry. Embrace the challenge of creating cutting-edge technologies that position us as leaders and be instrumental in charting the course to a future defined by innovation and excellence.

This role is focused on hands-on technical contribution and decision-making, technical oversight, and the enablement of engineering success rather than direct team management. • Evaluate emerging technologies and integrate them where they provide clear business value.

• Collaborate with engineering management to align execution with strategic priorities while avoiding unnecessary complexity.

• Balance opportunities and challenges across Roon’s product lines, ensuring collaboration between teams (e.g., Roon and Arc) where technical dependencies exist.

As Area Manager at HelloFresh, you get an important role in an international and growing company where you can influence the operation and develop both people and the organization.

A wellness allowance of SEK 3,000.

•
The opportunity to exercise during working hours.

•
A discounted price on HelloFresh meal boxes.

•
Regular staff activities.

•
The opportunity for skills development through a training budget.

The position involves work both in the office and out in production, where the temperature is about +5 °C.

If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we'd be excited to hear from you!

• Combine data from multiple sources into actionable recommendations

• Maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reporting processes

Strategy & Execution

• 5+ years of paid media / performance marketing experience

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams

Nice to Have

• Experience across additional channels including TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, or Trade Desk

• Familiarity with creative testing and messaging strategy

• Experience supporting integrated digital campaigns across multiple client verticals

Why Current

At Current , we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, well-crafted, and built to drive real impact.
We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across a wide range of digital engagements including websites, platforms, campaigns, and product experiences. You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and disciplines, contribute to meaningful work, and grow alongside a team that values curiosity, accountability, and strong operational thinking.
